name: Kinderib Arabic (Anatolian qəltu)

ancestors.notes: Inherited placeholder table; see notes on ar-TR-x-kinderib.

notes: Kinderib, Anatolia. A qəltu dialect, which is why the parent is the qeltu spec rather than a Levantine or gilit one; Anatolian qəltu is markedly divergent and the inherited table should not be trusted for it. ATTESTED, NOT YET DESCRIBED HERE. A published description exists and is named in `sources`; its phonology has not been read into this spec. The grapheme table is inherited from the parent and is a placeholder, NOT a claim about this variety — no reflex below has been checked against the source. The entry exists so the lect has a code and resolves to something usable rather than to nothing; `quality` is `stub` for exactly that reason. Replace the inherited table with cited reflexes before treating any reading here as this variety's.
